paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
heading: Enkhe Mite / (Diu 1.19-33)
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Israel suante ka piak, Kanaan gam va enkhe ding in mi sawl in. Anam inko chih ua mi, a-intekpa pen lak a mi khat chiat na sawl ding,” achi hi.
english: “Send men, that they may spy out the land of Canaan, which I give to the children of Israel. Of every tribe of their fathers, you shall send a man, every one a prince among them.”

paite: Mosi in Paran gamdai a pan TOUPA thupiak bang in akuansakta a; avek un Israel suante lak a intekpa pen chiat ahi uhi.
english: Moses sent them from the wilderness of Paran according to the commandment of Yahweh. All of them were men who were heads of the children of Israel.

paite: Hiaite amin uh ahi: Reuben nam lak a mi Zakkur tapa Shammua.
english: These were their names: Of the tribe of Reuben, Shammua the son of Zaccur.

paite: Simeon nam lak a mi Hori tapa Shaphat.
english: Of the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat the son of Hori.

paite: Judah nam lak a mi Jephunneh tapa Kaleb.
english: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

paite: Issakar nam lak a mi Joseph tapa Igal.
english: Of the tribe of Issachar, Igal the son of Joseph.

paite: Ephraim nam lak a mi Nun tapa Hoshea.
english: Of the tribe of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Nun.

paite: Benjamin nam lak a mi Raphu tapa Palti.
english: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Palti the son of Raphu.

paite: Zebulun nam lak a mi Sodi tapa Gaddiel.
english: Of the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel the son of Sodi.

paite: Joseph nam, Manasseh nam achih uh, lak a mi Susi tapa Gaddi.
english: Of the tribe of Joseph, of the tribe of Manasseh, Gaddi the son of Susi.

paite: Dan nam lak a mi Gemalli tapa Ammiel.
english: Of the tribe of Dan, Ammiel the son of Gemalli.

paite: Asher nam lak a mi Mikael tapa Sethur.
english: Of the tribe of Asher, Sethur the son of Michael.

paite: Naphtali nam lak a mi Vophsi tapa Nahbi.
english: Of the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi the son of Vophsi.

paite: Gad nam lak a mi Maki tapa Geuel.
english: Of the tribe of Gad, Geuel the son of Machi.

paite: Hiaite gam enkhe dia Mosi in asawlte min ahi. Mosi in Nun tapa Hoshea, Joshua achi hi.
english: These are the names of the men who Moses sent to spy out the land. Moses called Hoshea the son of Nun Joshua.

paite: Huchi in Mosi in Kanaan gam enkhe ding in amaute asawl a, akiang uah, "Simlam lampi ah pai phot unla, tangte ah kahtou un.
english: Moses sent them to spy out the land of Canaan, and said to them, “Go up this way by the South, and go up into the hill country.

paite: Huai gam bangchibang ahia, huai a teng mipite ahat uh hia, hat lou, atawm uh leh atam uh;
english: See the land, what it is; and the people who dwell therein, whether they are strong or weak, whether they are few or many;

paite: atenna gam uh ahoih hia hoih lou, a-omna khuate uh bangchibang ahia, puanin maimah hia, kulh nei;
english: and what the land is that they dwell in, whether it is good or bad; and what cities they are that they dwell in, whether in camps, or in strongholds;

paite: huai gam lei thau ahi hia, lei gawng, gammang om hia om lou chih va enkhia un. Hangsantak in om unla, huai gam theigahte hon pua un," achi hi. Tu grep gah masa gah hun laitak ahi.
english: and what the land is, whether it is fertile or poor, whether there is wood therein, or not. Be courageous, and bring some of the fruit of the land.” Now the time was the time of the first-ripe grapes.

paite: Huchi in akuantouta ua, huai gam Zin gamdai a pan Hamath lutna Rehob tan in a-enkhe vek uhi.
english: So they went up, and spied out the land from the wilderness of Zin to Rehob, to the entrance of Hamath.

paite: Simlam ah ahohtou phot ua, Hebron ava tung ua, huai ah Anak suan Ahiman, Sheshai leh Talmai a-om uhi. Hebron bel Aigupta gam a Zoan kilam ma kum sagih a kilam khinta ahi.
english: They went up by the South, and came to Hebron; and Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the children of Anak, were there. (Now Hebron was built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.)

paite: Eshkol Phaizang ava tung ua, huai ah grep gahbom khat ahiang toh asattan ua, chiang in mi nih in azawng uhi. Theibuhfai leh theipite leng apua uhi.
english: They came to the valley of Eshcol, and cut down from there a branch with one cluster of grapes, and they bore it on a staff between two. They also brought some of the pomegranates and figs.

paite: Israel suante'n huai a grep bom asatkhiak ziak un, huai mun Eshkol Phaizang asa uhi.
english: That place was called the valley of Eshcol, because of the cluster which the children of Israel cut down from there.

paite: Ni sawmli zoh in gam etkhiakna a pan ahong kik nawn uhi.
heading: Enkhe mite Kik Nawnna
english: They returned from spying out the land at the end of forty days.

paite: Huchi in Paran gamdai a Kadesh ah Mosi leh Aaron leh Israel suan mipi omkhawmte tengteng kiang ahong tung ua, akiang uah leh mipi omkhawmte tengteng kiang ah thu ahon tun ua, huai gam theite a-ensak uhi.
english: They went and came to Moses, to Aaron, and to all the congregation of the children of Israel, to the wilderness of Paran, to Kadesh; and brought back word to them and to all the congregation. They showed them the fruit of the land.

paite: Akiang ah, "N'on sawlna gam ah ka va hoh ua, bawngnawi leh khuaizu luanna ana hi ngei ngut a; hiai agam thei ahi.
english: They told him, and said, “We came to the land where you sent us. Surely it flows with milk and honey, and this is its fruit.

paite: Himahleh agam a mi tengte mihat pipi ahi ua, khuate leng kulh nei, thupi taktak ahi. Anak suante leng ka va mu uh.
english: However, the people who dwell in the land are strong, and the cities are fortified and very large. Moreover, we saw the children of Anak there.

paite: Simlam gam ah Amalekte ateng ua; tanggam ah Hitte, Jebuste, Amorte ateng uh. Tuipi gei leh Jordan luidung ah Kanaante ateng uh," chi in ahilh uhi.
english: Amalek dwells in the land of the South. The Hittite, the Jebusite, and the Amorite dwell in the hill country. The Canaanite dwells by the sea, and along the side of the Jordan.”

paite: Huchi in Mosi ma ah Kaleb in mipite adaisak khipkhep a, "Kisa tou zok ni in, va latou zok ni, i zou ngeingei ding uh," achi hi.
english: Caleb stilled the people before Moses, and said, “Let’s go up at once, and possess it; for we are well able to overcome it!”

paite: Himahleh ahohpihte'n, "I va zou vek thei kei ding e, ei sang in lah ahatzaw ngal ua," achi uhi.
english: But the men who went up with him said, “We aren’t able to go up against the people; for they are stronger than we.”

paite: Huchi in Israel suante kiang ah, "Ka va gam etkhiak uh gam, enkhe dia ka va vakna uh, asung a mi tengte nek khit hatmi ahi ua; ami om ka muhte uh mi awmkhauh pipi ahi uh.
english: They brought up an evil report of the land which they had spied out to the children of Israel, saying, “The land, through which we have gone to spy it out, is a land that eats up its inhabitants; and all the people who we saw in it are men of great stature.

paite: Huai ah Anak suante, miliante, awmkhauh pipi ka va mu ua; koute lah khaupe bang lel in ka va kimu ua, amau leng khaupe ek bang lel in ahon mu uh," chi in ahoih lou lam in agen uhi.
english: There we saw the Nephilim, the sons of Anak, who come from the Nephilim. We were in our own sight as grasshoppers, and so we were in their sight.”
